items.title: Make DONE closeout snapshot durable across merge and cleanup
items.context: Ensure milestone-closeout.json is committed or copied into canonical story metadata during real DONE advancement, before the story worktree is removed.
items.userSees: After DONE, `lattice milestone_closeout --storyId=<story>` prints the final milestone table instead of Snapshot: missing.

happy.desc: A real story worktree DONE path leaves milestone-closeout.json present in canonical story metadata after worktree cleanup.

edge.desc: A DONE story without a milestone ledger still does not fabricate a closeout snapshot and reports a clear missing/not-applicable diagnostic.

adversarial.desc: A transient worktree-only milestone-closeout.json cannot be considered delivered unless the canonical root can read it after DONE cleanup.

items.title: Add post-DONE canonical-root regression coverage
items.context: Extend or add tests so removing the durable handoff from DONE effects makes the test fail; the test must assert canonical-root milestone_closeout succeeds after DONE cleanup, not only that the helper wrote a file in the worktree.
items.userSees: The regression test fails if milestone_closeout would be missing from the canonical root after DONE.

happy.desc: The regression runs the full enough DONE path to prove canonical-root milestone_closeout reads a snapshot after cleanup.

edge.desc: The regression distinguishes canonical-root persistence from merely writing a worktree-local file.

adversarial.desc: The test fails if DONE cleanup deletes the only copy of milestone-closeout.json.
